entry_points.text: Test init exercises 32/64-bit atomic plain/acquire/release/relaxed checks and logs platform summary; exit unregisters.
Boot init registers five audit groups for read/write/dir-write/chattr/signal plus five compat groups when configured, returning success.

exports.text: Assoc staged edits: insert/delete/clear prepare with leaf delta, set_object revises pending leaf needing non-null, cancel frees staged nodes, destroy empties now. Edits carry array/ops, leaves, placement, count target, redirections, new/removed meta and parent updates; collapse keeps linkage/total omitting deleted leaf; clear alloc failure reports directly.

Assoc publish/collect: apply installs leaf then parent then backpointer then generic assignments with barriers, adds delta along ancestry and tree total, zeroes total on empty root and defers reclaim; gc rebuilds tree keeping only predicate-approved leaves, folding small nodes and removing indirection, leaving original unchanged on alloc failure.

Generic 64-bit atomics linearize on one hashed lock: locked read/write, add/sub/logic plain/new/old variants, dec-if-positive, cmpxchg returning old, xchg, add-unless; each holds lock for full RMW with irqs saved.
Audit classify: arch compat test; native syscall maps open/exec to opcodes else native fallback; compat variant maps same set else compat fallback; some numbers conditional on build.

Base64 by variant: triples to quads with optional pad, quads to triples; padded tail only at end when enabled, short tails only when disabled; returns length or -1 on bad symbol, misplaced pad, lone char or nonzero spare bits.

Scalar utils: packed-decimal byte to binary via nibbles, binary to packed via scaled tens; memset fills and returns dest; hex digit maps case-insensitively else -1; bounded search stops at target/NUL/bound; reverse extraction takes up to 8 hex backwards stopping at separator, failing on bad digit or 9th digit.

BCH codec: init validates m/t ranges and product bound, picks default primitive poly if zero, allocates tables/scratch, builds field/encoding, returns null on failure; control holds m/t/n, ecc sizes, swap flag and pow/log/mod8/xi/syn/cache/elp/poly; encode accumulates parity via tables; decode derives syndromes, locates errors and remaps; free releases.

Bitmap parse: user variant safely imports bounded buffer, treats import failure as error, parses with unbounded length and always frees temp; core converts hex groups with separators into sized words.

Formatting: kasprintf forwards to kvasprintf which measures with copied va_list, allocates len+1, rerenders and warns on mismatch, null on failure; vsnprintf guards oversize, copies literals with truncation, loops decode/dispatch for width/prec/char/str/ptr/percent with spec of flags/base/width/prec, terminates if allowed, returns full clamped length; number emits spaces/sign/prefix/pad/zeros/digits; put_dec splits 8-digit blocks via digit pairs.

hazards.text: Insert/delete alloc failure for nodes/shortcuts/edits aborts preparation, frees staged allocations, reports out-of-memory or null without installing partial structure.

Fatal on leaf-valued backpointer needing node, non-node ancestor during count fixup, unexpected meta during folding, excising leaf as subtree and invalid differences/skips; reclaim deferred past grace then frees dead leaf via callback, excised meta, excised subtree with ops, and edit.

BCH hazards: encode guards parity words against scratch capacity warning and returning; poly div/gcd/trace/factor mutate inputs and share non-reentrant scratch; alt root macro ignores k capturing caller len; alloc signals via err flag needing init/check; locations need reflection, out-of-range fails all, caller needs space for degree entries.

Bitmap bad digit yields EINVAL, excess words or significant bits beyond nbits yields EOVERFLOW with no partial result; decode oversize/missing yields EINVAL, locator/root failure yields EBADMSG; bitmap alloc failure yields ENOMEM; formatting clamps to INT_MAX, user parse uses UINT_MAX; bitmap print selects list/plain, formats, copies honoring offset/len, frees temp.

External helpers without dossier attribution in this group: spin/irq/barrier, alloc/error/array, bug/warn, printk/debug, audit compat/register, bitrev, atomic test interfaces; behavior owned elsewhere.

invariants.text: Assoc shape: terminal prefers equal-key replace then empty slot then split; replacement transfers parent link/position and child backrefs, retargets root if parentless; shortcut keeps index-key prefix to divergence, clearing bits beyond level.
Pools track occupancy, bound and list head; batch move refused if dest full or source empty, else one batch moves front-to-front with occupancies adjusted by batch size.
Five native audit class lists are persistent u32 arrays from generic header terminated by UINT_MAX.
Base64 has three 65-slot alphabets sharing alnum prefix differing in last two symbols, and three 256-entry reverse maps giving 6-bit values else -1, built by doubling helpers with invalid marking.

BCH params: m/t/n from config or control, ecc words/bytes from m*t rounded up with max words from maxima (dynamic maxima 15 for m, 64 for t; constant maxima equal config); byte parity preserves word order with optional per-byte bitrev and exact-length pad/truncate; field ops via tables with subtractive reduce, single-wrap reduce, msb degree and folded parity.

BCH math: syndromes clear spare bits, accumulate odd multiples from set bits, square for even; linear solve eliminates columns, enumerates free-param assignments and back-substitutes; affine assumes m<16; deg1 returns log root, deg2 uses trace tables, deg3 via shifted quartic discarding shift, deg4 via shift/invert; logrep normalizes divisor, mod eliminates high terms; zero-constant degenerate yields zero roots.

BCH build: div needs dividend deg>=divisor leaving remainder else zero quotient; gcd orders by degree then repeated remainder; trace iterates m times squaring/reducing; factor via trace+gcd storing in place; roots dispatch 1-4 else recursive split bounded by m; chien scans trailing data+redundancy window needing full-degree matches; gf/mod8/deg2/generator validate and build; init enforces m>=5, t bounds and product bound.

Bitmap parse scans backward to newline, trims ws/comma via reverse region step, consumes hex groups into words low-to-high with be pairing, fails if more words needed, clears spare bits, fails on significant bits beyond nbits.

locks.text: Atomic64 serializes on hashed spinlocks from shifted address; save irqs, lock, touch counter, unlock, restore.

state_machines.text: Insert dispatches by walk: empty creates root, terminal delegates to terminal handling, mismatched shortcut divides; any alloc failure cancels. Full terminal either splits by key segment or inserts skip shortcut to first difference then splits; shortcut division excises mismatch, installs central node, keeps leading/trailing skips, places old subtree and new leaf.

Apply publishes leaf, parent slots, backpointers, generics separated by barriers, then fixes counts and defers reclaim; gc descends/duplicates, filters leaves, folds small children, excises indirection-only nodes, removes indirection above leaf-only nodes, ascends and publishes new root/total.

BCH decode validates size, uses supplied or derived syndromes with early success on redundancy match, builds locator iterating to t with current/prev polys failing if degree>t, searches roots, reflects locations around total length plus optional in-byte bitrev, fails all on out-of-range, else reports locator degree; poly copy duplicates header+coeffs.

structs.text: Collapse cursor holds dest node, leaf identity to omit, next free index; recompaction fatal on slot overflow.
Atomic hash table has 16 entries each spinlock plus cacheline-sized padding aligned; index masks mixed hash; lock count is 16.
Galois poly is degree plus flexible coefficients in term order, size header+(deg+1)*entry; deg1 overlay embeds two coefficients.
